title: SEKOYA® Beauty™ 'FCM12-097'
summary: Owner catalogue entry claiming jumbo size, very firm fruit and 45 days of storage. No storage temperature, packaging or quality threshold is given.
why_it_matters: Owner-published trait descriptions are the marketing baseline against which independent trial and registry descriptions should be compared. Storage-day figures in particular are stated without any protocol and cannot be treated as measurements.

reading.rationale: Short catalogue entries; the substance is a handful of claims.

testing.rationale: Every claim here is a candidate for independent verification.

commercial_position.rationale: Marketing language indicates how the owner positions the variety, not how it performs.

monitoring.rationale: Catalogue text is revised roughly annually.
